The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1

Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح327 : ‫تحلم مانات وهي طاهية شابة موهوبة أحلاما كبيرة، لكنها تواجه عقبة كأداء وهي صاحبة عملها القاسية آيشواريا. تكون آيشواريا هي أيضا والدة مانات الحقيقية التي تخلت عنها عند ولادتها دون علمهما.‬‬ S1 , E327 : Mannat, a gifted young chef, dreams big but faces a formidable obstacle, her ruthless employer Aishwarya. Unknown to both, Aishwarya is also Mannat's birth mother who abandoned her when she was born.

programme.title: مانغال لاكشمي - Mangal Lakshmi
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح663 : ‫ينطلق مانغال في رحلة للبحث عن شريك مثالي لـلاكشمي، لكن الحب والمحن يختبران أواصر أخوتهما، كاشفين عن قوة القدر.‬‬ S1 , E663 : Adit chooses Saumya over Mangal, but soon meets with a severe accident. Later, Jiya discloses that Lakshmi and Karthik are the baby's parents, shocking everyone.

programme.title: ما ها ديف أند سانز - Mahadev & Sons

Meanwhile, devastated by Madhu's marriage, Ashish drowns his sorrow in alcohol.

programme.title: نويونتارا - Noyontara
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح236 : ‫تعلم شاولي أن شبحا سيفسد زفافها من سورجو بعد تحذير باريندا لها. لاحقا، يحاول شاشادار اليائس الانتحار، بينما تصاب شاولي بالذهول من رعب تحذير باريندا.‬‬ S1 , E236 : Noyontara's ability to communicate with spirits enables her to bridge the gap between realms and uncover veiled truths. Her marriage into the Sengupta family sets in motion a series of revelations.

programme.title: تو جوليت جات دي - Tuu Juliet Jatt Di
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح75 : ‫تلتقي الفتاة الطموحة هير بالشاب المميز نواب، مما يشعل شرارة لقصة حب غير متوقعة. في خضم تحديات رحلتهما، تتكتشف حكاية حب متشابكة تنطوي على الخداع والاضطراب العاطفي.‬‬ S1 , E75 : Gulaab and Dilip have a bitter argument and Heer blames herself for causing the divide between them. Later, Nawab becomes intoxicated and imagines Heer before him.

Mrs. Garcia strives to give daughters Valeria and Mar a better future, shielding them from poverty. She'll stop at nothing to see her dreams reflected in them and enforce high standards even if the cost is her daughters' happiness.

programme.title: لاكسور - Luxor
programme.desc: عندما تعود هانا عاملة الإغاثة البريطانية إلى مدينة الأقصر القديمة، تلتقي مع سلطان. وبينما هي تتجول، يطاردها المكان المألوف، وتسعى للتوفيق بين خيارات الماضي وعدم اليقين في الحاضر. When British aid worker Hana returns to the ancient city of Luxor, she meets Sultan, a friend from her past. As she wanders, haunted by the familiar place, she struggles to reconcile the choices of the past with the uncertainty of the present.

programme.title: هوم غرون DXB - Homegrown DXB
programme.desc: انضموا إلينا لنكتشف معاً قصص رواد الأعمال الذين يقودون المشهد التجاري الديناميكي في دبي! من المشاريع الرائدة إلى القصص الملهمة، نتعمق في عقول هؤلاء رواد الأعمال الاستثنائيين، ونكشف عن رحلاتهم الشخصية. Join us as we uncover the stories behind the visionaries driving Dubai's dynamic business landscape! From groundbreaking ventures to inspiring narratives, we delve deep into the minds of these exceptional entrepreneurs, revealing their personal journeys.

programme.title: أخبار الإمارات - Emirates News
programme.desc: تابعوا أخبار الإمارات من المصدر الأكثر توازناً ومصداقية، أخبار الإمارات المحلية من قنوات دبي. Tune in to Emirates News, the most balanced and credible source of local news on television.

programme.title: DXB اليوم - DXB Today
programme.desc: يسلط البرنامج الضوء على مختلف جوانب الحياة في دبي، ويركز على الأحداث الأخيرة، صانعي المحتوى، ورواد الموضة والابتكار في دبي. Your guide to the biggest events, and the people dominating the headlines, from the trendsetters to the innovators, in the city of Dubai and beyond.

programme.title: بنات السيدة غارسيا - LAS HIJAS DE LA SEÑORA GARCÍA
programme.desc: تسعى السيدة غارسيا جاهدة لتوفير مستقبل أفضل لابنتيها فاليريا ومار، وحمايتهما من الفقر. ولن تدخر جهداً في سبيل تحقيق أحلامها، وفرض معايير عالية حتى لو كان الثمن سعادة ابنتيها. Mrs. Garcia strives to give daughters Valeria and Mar a better future, shielding them from poverty. She'll stop at nothing to see her dreams reflected in them and enforce high standards even if the cost is her daughters' happiness.

programme.title: ذا بارتي - The Party
programme.desc: كوميديا، بطولة كريستين سكوت توماس وتيموثي سبول. تقيم جانيت حفل عشاء لأصدقائها المقربين للاحتفال بترقيتها التي طال انتظارها. لكن مع تقدم الليل، تظهر الأسرار السوداء المشينة، ودرجة الاستياء تصل لمرحلة الغليان. Comedy starring Kristin Scott Thomas and Timothy Spall. Janet throws a dinner party for her closest friends to celebrate her much-awaited promotion, but as the night progresses, dark secrets and simmering resentments surface.

programme.title: ذا فاميلي - The Family
programme.desc: روبيرت دي نيرو وميشيل فايفر في درو البطولة في هذا الفيلم الكوميدي التشويقي. تدور الأحداث حول عائلة رجل مافيا نقلت إلى فرنسا تحت حراسة مؤسسة حماية الشهود. Robert De Niro and Michelle Pfeiffer star in this action comedy about an American ex-Mafia boss and his family who are transplanted to France via the Witness Protection Program.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 18 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 18
programme.desc: يتفق حزلقوم مع أشرف على مكيدة تتيح للأخير الدخول إلى السجن، بينما يرسم جوني والكبير خطة لسرقة مفتاح مكتب المأمور. Hazalqoum and Ashraf scheme to get the latter to enter prison. Meanwhile, Johnny and Al Kabeer plan to steal the officer’s key.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 19 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 19
programme.desc: يزج حزلقوم بكل من هجرس وبعزق والدكتور ربيع في السجن بتهمة السرقة من أجل مساعدة الكبير على الهرب، وفي كل مرة يحاولون فيها الهرب يتم الإمساك بهم وحبسهم انفرادياً. In an attempt to help Al Kabeer escape, Hazalqoum sends Hajras, Baazaq and Dr. Rabee to prison for theft. But every time they try to escape, they get caught.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 20 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 20
programme.desc: يؤدي الكبير وأشرف وهجرس وبعزق وربيع مسرحية هاملت فوق خشبة مسرح السجن، وفي مشهد النهاية، يختفي الجميع أسفل المسرح من أجل الهروب. Al Kabeer, Ashraf, Hajras, Baazaq and Rabee perform the play Hamlet onstage in prison in hopes of making a successful escape attempt.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 21 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 21
programme.desc: يتعاون كل من كرم والكبير في تنفيذ خطة يقومان من خلالها بالتنكر في زي رجال الشرطة ومحاولة الهرب من السجن، في حين يظهر في السجن صاحب الوكر الذي تواجد به الكبير لحظة القبض عليه متلبساً. Karam and Al Kabeer go undercover as policemen to escape from prison. Later, the owner of the lair where Al Kabeer was caught appears in prison.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 22 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 22
programme.desc: يفتتح هجرس محل بقالة صغير، ولاحقاً يقترح على جوني العودة إلى التمثيل على أن ينتج حزلقوم له الفيلم، وبالفعل يطرح جوني على الأخير الموضوع ويفاجأ عندما يعلم أنه يستثمر أمواله في السينما. Hajras opens a grocery shop and advises Johnny to resume his acting career. Johnny asks Hazalqoum to produce a new movie and is surprised to learn that he is already investing his money in the movies.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 23 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 23
programme.desc: يقرر حزلقوم اتخاذ فيلا الكبير كموقع لتصوير فيلمه الجديد لكن الكبير يرفض ذلك، فيقترح عليه أشرف إرساله من أجل قضاء العمرة أثناء تصويرهم للفيلم وسط حيرة جوني بطل الفيلم حول هوية البطلة التي يخفيها عنه حتى تلك اللحظة. Hazalqoum decides to use Al Kabeer’s villa as a shooting set but when he refuses, Ashraf tries to manipulate Al Kabeer by suggesting that he travel abroad to perform Umrah. Meanwhile, Johnny is eager to know who the main female character is.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 24 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 24
programme.desc: يصطدم جوني بانحطاط مستوى الممثلة التي اختارها حزلقوم للعب دور البطولة أمامه، بينما تحتفل تلك الممثلة والتي تدعى نور مع حزلقوم قبل بدء تصوير الفيلم الجديد. Johnny is shocked at how bad the performance of the main female character Noor is. Later, Hazalqoum and Noor celebrate together before shooting their new film.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 25 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 25
programme.desc: اثناء تصوير من الفيلم الجديد، إلا أن وصول الكبير إلى موقع التصوير يدفع بالجميع إلى الهرب من الفيلا، أما الأخير فيعجب بالممثلة نور التي تطلب منه مشاركتها في دور البطولة عوضا عن جوني. While shooting the first scene of the movie, Al Kabeer’s unexpected arrival causes a frenzy of fear and everyone flees the villa. Later, Noor asks Al Kabeer to star in the movie with her instead of Johnny.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 26 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 26
programme.desc: نيزكاً عملاقاً سيضرب الأرض والقاهرة أنالكبرى خلال أسبوع و يتكون من مادة لا يعرف عنها علماء الأرض شيئاً ولم يقدم عنها أبحاث سوى حزلقوم، لذى يلجأ فريق مصري خاص بعلوم الفضاء إلى حزلقوم من أجل تفجير ذلك النيزك في الفضاء. A rush of panic engulfs everyone when they hear that a meteor will hit Cairo, and that it consists of an unknown substance. When a team of scientists learn that Hazalqoum is the only one who did a research on the substance, they seek his help.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 27 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 27
programme.desc: يتعرف عالم الفضاء المصري ممدوح على فريق حزلقوم ويجري عليهم فحوصات طبية ونفسية لكنها تفشل، ليتم اختيارهم مؤخراً لتنفيذ مهمة تفجير النيزك، وبالفعل يستعد الفريق داخل المكوك الفضائي للإقلاع إلى الفضاء. Egyptian astronaut Mamdouh meets Hazalqoum’s team, which has been chosen to carry out the mission of destroying the meteor. The members undergo medical and psychological tests and prepare to mount the space shuttle.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 28 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 28
programme.desc: ينطلق حزلقوم وفريقه إلى الفضاء وأثناء هبوطهم على سطح النيزك ينقطع الإرسال بينهم وبين المحطة الأرضية، فيقرروا إرسال صواريخ نووية لتفجير النيزك. When Hazalqoum and his team land on the meteor, they lose connection with Earth, and decide to send nuclear missiles to detonate the meteor.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 29 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 29
programme.desc: يتشاجر حزلقوم مع ممدوح حول الوسائل المستخدمة في حفر النيزك، ثم يغادرهم ممدوح إلى المكوك في محاولة منه للاتصال بالأرض، ويجد قائد المكوك علي يشتكي من الأضرار التي لحقت بالمكوك. Hazalqoum and Mamdouh quarrel over how to destroy the meteor. Later, while Mamdouh tries to reconnect with Earth, Ali realizes that the space shuttle has been severely damaged.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 1 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 1
programme.desc: في ظل غياب زوجته، يتدهور حال الكبير عندما ينشغل بالاعتناء بولديه التوأم، ويهمل واجباته كعمدة. In the absence of his wife, Al Kabeer’s state worsens when he gets busy taking care of his twins and neglects his duties as a village chief.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 2 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 2
programme.desc:
تزداد مشاكل الكبير سوءا عندما يتناول ابنه جرعة من اختراع الدكتور ربيع تحوله إلى شاب ضخم.
Al Kabeer’s problems intensify when his son consumes a dosage of Doctor Rabee’s invention that turns him into a giant.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 3 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 3
programme.desc: تظهر عمة الكبير على الساحة بعد أن تعلم بإمكانية سحب اللقب من العائلة. يقابل الكبير عمته التي تضع شرطا عليه لكي يتفرغ لعمله. Al Kabeer’s aunt returns after hearing that the family’s chiefdom may be revoked. The aunt sets a condition on Al Kabeer to return to his job.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 4 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 4
programme.desc:
تختار العمة زوجة للكبير الذي تظهر علامات الضغط عليه بسبب شرط جديد تضعه عليه بشأن الزواج.
The aunt picks a wife for Al Kabeer, who begins to feel pressured by the changes in his life. A new condition is set by the aunt on Al Kabeer’s marriage.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 5 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 5
programme.desc: يسعى الكبير لإيجاد الحب من جديد بعد غياب زوجته، غير مدرك بأن ما يبحث عنه أقرب مما يتصور. Al Kabeer seeks to find love again after his wife was gone, unaware that what he is looking for is closer than he imagines.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 6 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 6
programme.desc: يسعى الكبير لإيجاد الحب من جديد بعد غياب زوجته، غير مدرك بأن ما يبحث عنه أقرب مما يتصور. Al Kabeer seeks to find love again after his wife was gone, unaware that what he is looking for is closer than he imagines.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 7 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 7
programme.desc: يتعرض الكبير وعائلته لعملية خطف حيث يستدرجون فيها إلى مكان مجهول ويجبرون على الاشتراك في لعبة تماثيل إسكندرية. Al Kabeer and his family are kidnapped and brought to an unknown site. Meanwhile, they are forced to participate in a game of Alexandria’s statues.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 8 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 8
programme.desc: تزداد حدة التوتر في الأرجاء حيث يفعل كل من الكبير وعائلته وأهل المزاريطة كل ما بوسعهم للخروج. تستمر المسابقات في مكان الاختطاف. Tensions intensify as Al Kabeer, his family, and the people of Mazareeta work hard to free themselves. The contests at the abduction sites remain on-going.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 9 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 9
programme.desc: على الرغم من مرور ثلاثة أيام على اختطاف الكبير وأهل المزاريطة، يشترك الآخرون في مسابقتي شد الحبل وجوز أو فرد. After three days have passed since the kidnapping of Al Kabeer and Mazareeta’s people, others participate in a competition with ropes and odd even games.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 10 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 10
programme.desc: يحاول الكبير وعائلته الهرب من مكان اختطافهم، ولكن سرعان ما تظهر هوية الخاطف ليكتشفوا بأن ما حصل لهم ما هو إلا جزء من لعبة ما. While Kabeer and his family attempt to escape, the kidnapper’s identity is revealed. Al Kabeer discovers that the abduction was part of a game.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 11 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 11
programme.desc: يعود الجميع إلى الدوار بينما يأتي أخ الكبير في زيارة مفاجئة ليطلب منه مساعدته في العثور على أم ابنه. Al Kabeer's brother surprises him in a visit, seeking Al Kabeer's help in finding his son's mother.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 12 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 12
programme.desc: يزور حزلقوم جميع زوجاته باحثا عن أم ابنه، بادئا بأمينو لاعبة رفع الأثقال وأمجاد المثقفة. في هذه الأثناء، يقضي حلقوم وقته مع أولاد الكبير. Hazalqoum visits his many wives in search of his son’s mother, starting with weightlifting Amino and educated Amjad. Halqoum spends time with Al Kabeer’s kids.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 13 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 13
programme.desc: يكتشف الكبير سرقة ممتلكات عديدة من منزله وعرضها للبيع في المزاد العلني. يصر حزلقوم على إنجاز مهمته حيث يذهب إلى زوجته السابقة، النجمة نرمين. Al Kabeer discovers that multiple items were stolen from him and are being set for sale. Intent on fulfilling his task, Hazalqoum goes to his ex-wife, Nermine.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 14 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 14
programme.desc: للهروب من المتنمرين، يدعي العترة بأنه مريض، ولكن يتدخل الكبير في محاولة للقضاء على كل أنواع التنمر في المدرسة. Al Atra feigns sickness to escape his bullies at school, but Al Kabeer gets involved and attempts to put a stop to all types of bullying.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 15 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 15
programme.desc: يسعى جوني وهجرس لنيل الشهرة على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي من خلال تصوير فيديو بمساعدة نفادي. Johnny and Hagras try to go viral on social media by making a video with Nafadi as an extra.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 16 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 16
programme.desc: ينتشر هوس منصات التواصل الاجتماعي في القرية. تشعر مربوحة بالغيرة من المحتوى الذي يثير إعجاب الكبير. يخون هجرس ثقة جوني فيه. People around the village become more and more obsessed with social media. Al Kabeer’s content of choice makes Marbouha jealous while Hagras betrays Johnny.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 17 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 17
programme.desc: تنمو العداوة بين جوني وهجرس بشكل خطير بسبب منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. تحاول مربوحة أن تلفت نظر الكبير من خلال ارتداء ملابس جريئة. The social media feud between Johnny and Hagras grows dangerously. Marbouha resorts to wearing bold fashion to get Al Kabeer’s attention.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 18 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 18
programme.desc: بعد أن يفقد الأمل في التغلب على هجرس، يقرر جوني شراء مشاهدات ومتابعين لصفحاته، ويطلب المال من الكبير، ولكنه يقابل بردة فعل عنيفة. Desperate to overcome Hagras, Johnny decides to buy social media followers and asks Al Kabeer for money, but the request is met with a violent reaction.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 19 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 19
programme.desc: تزور والدة الكبير مربوحة وتشعل مشاكل في القرية عندما يتم منعها من دخول مركز الشباب. Al Kabeer’s mother visits Marbouha and makes a scene when she’s denied entry into the gentlemen’s club.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 6 الحلقة 20 - Al Kabeer Awi Season 6 Episode 20
programme.desc: يحاول هجرس إقناع الكبير بالابتعاد عن الأعمال العنيفة ويدعيه إلى عرض وجهة نظره في فيديو على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. تنظم السيدات مظاهرة ضد الرجال. Hagras tries to talk Al Kabeer out of taking violent action and invites him to speak up on his social media channel. Infuriated, the women organize a protest.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 1 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 1
programme.desc: يشعر الكبير بالملل والإرهاق في حياته بعد زواجه من مربوحة. يبدأ جوني العمل على مشروعه لافتتاح صالة رياضية. Al Kabeer experiences boredom in his life after his marriage to Marbouha. Johnny moves forward with his plan to open a gym.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 2 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 2
programme.desc: بعد التنصت إلى أحد اتصالات الكبير، تطلب مربوحة مساعدة جوني وهجرس لفتح جواله، وتتبعه بحثا عن الحقيقة. After overhearing one of Al Kabeer’s phone calls, Marbouha enlists the help of Johnny and Hagras to unlock his phone and find out if he's cheating on her.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 3 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 3
programme.desc: يخيب أمل جوني عندما يكتشف أن الناس لا تهتم لاستخدام صالته الرياضية كما توقع. لم تجر جلسة الاستشارة الزوجية للكبير ومربوحة لمصلحتها. Johnny is disappointed to find out that people don’t care to use his gym the way he intended. Al Kabeer and Marbouha’s marriage counselling session goes badly for her.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 4 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 4
programme.desc: بعد فشل الكبير ومربوحة في تنفيذ مهمتها الأولى، تعرض الدكتورة عليهما محاولة جديدة، ولكنهما يواجهان مشاكل كثيرة. After they failed at fulfilling her first assignment, the doctor suggests that Al Kabeer and Marbouha try something new but various issues get in their way.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 5 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 5
programme.desc: في محاولة أخيرة لإنقاذ علاقتهما، يستمع الكبير ومربوحة إلى نصيحة الدكتورة جميلة ويسافران إلى القاهرة للهروب من الروتين الذي يتسبب بالخلافات بينهما. In a final attempt to save their marriage, Al Kabeer and Marbouha listen to Jameela and travel to Cairo to escape the routine causing their constant fights.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 6 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 6
programme.desc: للمحطة التالية في جولتهما حول القاهرة، يصطحب الكبير مربوحة إلى المركز التجاري. ولكن عندما يتركها وحدها للحظة، تقع في خطر شديد بسبب براءتها. As their next stop in touring Cairo, Al Kabeer takes Marbouha to a mall. But when he leaves her alone for a moment, her innocence puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 7 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 7
programme.desc: بينما يبحث الكبير ونفادي عنها باستخدام كل الدلائل الموجودة، تحاول مربوحة إيجاد طريقة للهروب من منزل فخري. While Al Kabeer and Nafadi follow the available leads to find her, Marbouha looks for a way to escape Fakhri’s house.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 8 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 8
programme.desc: يحقق الكبير مع أحمد السقا لمعرفة ما إذا كان هو خاطف مربوحة التي تفقد الأمل من أن يتم إنقاذها. Al Kabeer interrogates Ahmed ElSaka to see if he is Marbouha’s kidnapper, while she despairs at ever being saved.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 9 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 9
programme.desc: عندما يجد جوني نفسه بحاجة إلى فلوس، يعلمه هجرس كيف يحصل عليها من خلال منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. When Johnny finds himself in need of money, Hagras shows him how to get it through social media and followers.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 10 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 10
programme.desc: عندما يحصد الفيديو الذي سجلاه ملايين المشاهدات، يزور جوني شروق التي تقترح عليه فكرة قد تزيد عدد متابعيهم على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي وتكسبهم مزيدا من الأموال. When their video reaches millions of views, Johnny visits Shourou’ who gives him an an idea that could increase the number of their followers and earn them more money.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 11 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 11
programme.desc: يخبر جوني مربوحة عن خطوبته ويطلب منها أن تحفظ سره. ينجح اتفاق شروق وجوني، ولكن هذه الأخيرة تقوم بتصرف غير متوقع. Johnny tells Marbouha the truth about his engagement and swears her to secrecy. Shourou’ and Johnny’s plan is a success, but she takes it a step too far.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 12 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 12
programme.desc: عندما يحاول جوني إنهاء صفقته مع شروق، تذكره بالأوراق التي وقعها. يقيم الثنائي حفل خطوبة، الأمر الذي يثير استياء الكبير. When Johnny tries to get out of his deal with Shourou’, she reminds him of the papers he signed. To Al Kabeer’s displeasure, the couple throw an engagement party.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 13 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 13
programme.desc: عندما يقع عترة في مشكلة خلال بطولة الكاراتيه، يطالب الكبير الدكتور ربيع بالتركيبة التي ستعيد ابنه إلى حالته الطبيعية. When Etra gets into trouble during a karate competition, Al Kabeer asks Dr. Rabee’ for the potion that will bring his son back to normal.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 14 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 14
programme.desc: بعد اكتشاف حالة عترة الجديدة، يعود الكبير إلى الدكتور ربيع للانتقام. يجري جوني وهجرس تجارب أداء لإيجاد ممثلين لمسرحيتهما. After seeing Etra in his new state, Al Kabeer returns to Dr. Rabi’ for revenge. Johnny and Hagras hold auditions for their play.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 15 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 15
programme.desc: يرسل الكبير رجاله للبحث عن الدكتور ربيع. يصاب عترة بوعكة صحية. يكتشف جوني أن هجرس يتلقى رشاوى من أشخاص لقاء مشاركتهم في المسرحية. Al Kabeer sends his men to search for Dr. Rabi’. Etra has a health setback. Johnny finds out that Hagras is taking bribes from people looking to act in the play.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 16 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 16
programme.desc: يتابع الكبير بحثه عن الدكتور ربيع. خلال البروفة الأولى، يبدو النص الذي اختاره هجرس مألوفا لجوني. Al Kabeer pursues his search for Dr. Rabi’. During the first rehearsal, the script chosen by Hagras seems familiar to Johnny.

programme.title: الكبير أوي موسم 7 حلقة 17 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 17
programme.desc: عندما يكتشف جوني أن كذبة عترة لفتت اهتمام وسائل الإعلام، يقرر استخدام الأمر لمصلحته، غير مدرك الخطر القادم. يحصل الكبير على تركيبة جديدة. When Johnny finds out that Etra’s lie got the media’s attention, he decides to use it to his advantage, unaware of the incoming danger. Al Kabeer gets a new formula.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 18 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 18
programme.desc: يستحوذ حزلقوم على مصنع جوارب على وشك الإفلاس ويكتشف خلال زيارته الأولى المشاكل العديدة التي يتوجب عليه حلها. لاحقا، يلتقي عن طريق الخطأ بعدوه اللدود. Hazalqoum gets his hands on a failing sock factory and discovers, on his first visit, the multiple issues he must deal with. Later, he runs into his arch nemesis.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 19 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 19
programme.desc: عندما يقتحم فاروق مقابلته التلفزيونية، يضع حزلقوم رهانا ضخما ضده. بعد إدراكه للخطأ الذي ارتكبه، يطلب من الكبير ونفادي مساعدته لإصلاح خطئه. When Farouq crashes his TV interview, Hazalqoum makes a large bet against him. Then, realizing the mistake he just made, he seeks Al Kabeer and Nafadi's help to fix it.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 20 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 20
programme.desc: بعد تدريب لاعبي فريق نادي كرة قدم المزاريطة، يقترح ربيع تنظيم مباراة ودية لاختبار قدراتهم. يحاول حزلقوم التأثير على نتيجة المباراة. After training the new players of Al Mazarita FC, Rabi’ proposes organizing a friendly match to test them. Hazalqoum tries to affect the outcome of the game.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 21 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 21
programme.desc: بينما يوشك حزلقوم على التراجع عن الرهان، يقرر الكبير مساعدته. بعد أن تم رفض طلب انضمامه إلى الفريق، يسعى هجرس للانتقام. Right when Hazalqoum is about to back out on the bet, Al Kabeer decides to help him. Hagras’ plea to join the team having been rejected, he seeks revenge.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 22 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 22
programme.desc: بينما تبدأ المباراة، يصعب على اللاعبين وأهالي المزاريطة تقبل خيانة هجرس، ولكن هذا الأخير يخبئ سرا قد يغير المعادلة. As the match begins, Hagras’ betrayal hits the team and the residents of Al Mazarita hard, but the latter is hiding a secret that could change the outcome of the game.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 23 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 23
programme.desc: تعود الكبيرة إلى المزاريطة لتعلن خبرا مهما لأبناء أخيها. يبدأ الكبير في البحث عن عدوه اللدود ريثما يصله خبر وجوده في القرية. Al Kabeera returns to Al Mazarita with important news to share with her nephews. Al Kabeer finds out that his arch nemesis is in town and starts searching for him.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 24 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 24
programme.desc: يطلب جوني مساعدة هجرس لمعرفة كيفية كسب احترام خطيب الكبيرة، بينما يحاول الكبير معرفة هوية هذا الأخير مهما كلفه الأمر. Johnny asks for Hagras’ help to make an impression on Al Kabeera’s fiancé, while Al Kabeer goes to extremes to find out who he is.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 25 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 25
programme.desc: يأتي حفني الديب إلى الدوار لطلب الزواج من الكبيرة، ولكن عدم إلمام جوني بالعادات والتقاليد يبطئ الإجراءات. Hofny El Dib arrives to Al Dawar to ask for Al Kabeera’s hand in marriage, but Johnny’s unfamiliarity with local traditions slows down the proceedings.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 26 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 26
programme.desc: عندما تفشل محاولات الكبير لإبعاد حفني عن عمته، يقرر أن يقتله، غير مدرك أن ثمة من لديه خطة مماثلة. After his various attempts at coming between Hofny and Al Kabeera fail, Al Kabeer decides to kill him, unaware that someone else has a similar plan.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 27 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 27
programme.desc: ينفذ الكبير خطته للتخلص من حفني. بينما يوشك على النجاح في مهمته، تقتحم مجموعة من المسلحين حفل الزفاف. Al Kabeer sets his plan to get rid of Hofny in motion. Just when he is about to succeed, armed men crash the wedding.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 28 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 28
programme.desc: عندما يجد نفسه في موقف صعب، يتذكر الممثل محمد سلام ما حدث له يوم مهرجان المزاريطة السينمائي ويذهب لزيارة هجرس. When he finds himself stuck in a tough situation, Mohamed Sallam remembers what happened to him during the Mazarita film festival and pays Hagras a visit.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 29 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 29
programme.desc: يقبض الكبير على سلام بسبب جرائم هجرس الذي يتلقى زيارة من البرينس. Sallam is arrested by Al Kabeer for Hagras’ crimes while the latter gets a visit from Al Prince.

programme.title: الكبير أوي الموسم 7 الحلقة 30 - El Kebeer Awi Season 7 Episode 30
programme.desc: الحلقة الأخيرة: يبدأ هجرس تصوير المسلسل المستوحى من حياته بعنوان "الكبير". يتسلل سلام وجوني إلى موقع التصوير للانتقام. SEASON FINALE: Hagras starts shooting his series “Al Kabeer,” inspired by his life. Johnny and Sallam sneak onto the set to get their revenge.

programme.desc: قبل وفاته، يفصح عمدة قرية في الصعيد لابنه بأن لديه أخ توأم في الغربة ومن حقه المطالبة بنصف الميراث، والترشح ضده لمنصب العمدة. Before his death, a village chief reveals to his son that he has a twin abroad who can claim half the inheritance and challenge him for the title.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 1 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 1
programme.desc: يستقبل كل من حزلقوم والكبير شقيقهما السوداني نعيم والذي تتسم شخصيته بالكسل الشديد، فيرفض الكبير الاعتراف به كشقيق له في بادئ الأمر حتى يوضح له نعيم نيته في مشاركتهما لإرث والدهم. Hazalqoum and Al Kabeer meet their lazy Sudanese brother Naeem. At first, Al Kabeer did not accept Naeem as his brother, until the latter tells him that he wants to share their father’s inheritance.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 2 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 2
programme.desc: يتفق الكبير على المبلغ الذي سيحصل عليه لقاء تنازله هو وأشقائه عن نصيبهم في شركة الأدوية التركية ويحصل على مبلغ صغير نقداً ويرحل، في حين يتعقبه اثنان من اللصوص. Al Kabeer comes to an agreement about how much money he will receive when he and his brothers forfeit their share of the Turkish pharmaceutical company. Two thieves follow him when he leaves with his money.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 3 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 3
programme.desc: يستعيد الكبير وعيه ويكتشف بأنه فقد ذاكرته، وتقوم الممرضة بلاعتناء به، في حين يحضر حزلقوم إلى تركيا ويتجه إلى صديقه وهو زعيم عصابة ويطلب منه مساعدته في إجاد شقيقه. When Al Kabeer wakes up with no memories, the nurse assures him that she will take care of him until they discover who he is. Meanwhile, Hazalqoum reaches Turkey and asks his friend and mob boss to help him find his brother.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 4 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 4
programme.desc: يتعلم الكبير اللغة التركية، فيما يسمع لاحقاً ضوضاء في الشقة المجاورة فيذهب إلى هناك ويجد فتاة تحاول الانتحار. Al Kabeer studies the Turkish language and later, he hears ruckus from the apartment next door. When he goes to check it out, he finds a girl on the verge of committing suicide.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 5 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 5
programme.desc: يكتشف مساعد حزلقوم وجود خائن بينهم وهو الذي تسبب في مقتل زعيمهم السابق يوري، في حين يبدي الكبير إعجابه بجارته التي يخرج للتنزه معها. Hazalqoum’s assistant discovers that there is a mole among them who was involved in Yuri’s death. Elsewhere, Al Kabeer seems to be infatuated with his neighbour.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 6 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 6
programme.desc: يعمل الكبير كعامل نظافة في صالة ملاكمةلبابا دوبلاس، لاحقاً يتنزه مع جارته التي تقترح عليه الذهاب إلى السفارة المصرية بعد أن أخبره بابا دوبلاس بأن لهجته مصرية. Al Kabeer begins working as a janitor in Baba Doublas’s boxing gym where he trains after hours. Later, when Baba Doublas confirms that Al Kabeer’s accent is Egyptian, the latter’s neighbour suggests that they visit the Egyptian embassy.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 7 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 7
programme.desc: تعجب زوجة ساشا بحزلقوم، في حين يسخر أحد أبطال الملاكمة من الكبير أثناء تنظيفه أرضية الصالة، الأمر الذي يثير غضبه ويجعله يطلب منازلته. Sasha’s wife is infatuated with Hazalqoum, who gives her his phone number. Elsewhere, a boxing champion heckles Al Kabeer as he cleans the gym.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 8 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 8
programme.desc: يكتشف صاروف بيك وهو زعيم عصابة في تركيا أن الكبير على علاقة غرامية بابنته، فيأمر رجاله بوقف استخراج أوراق ثبوتية للكبير، ويعترض طريقه لاحقاً بمساعدة رجاله أثناء تواجده بصحبة ابنته. When Sarouf Beik, a mob boss in Turkey, discovers that Al Kabeer is in a relationship with his daughter, he orders his men to stop helping him. Later, they interrupt Al Kabeer while he is out with his girlfriend.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 9 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 9
programme.desc: ينازل الكبير العديد من الملاكمين ويتغلب عليهم، في حين يتصل جوني بحزلقوم ويسأله عن آخر المستجدات بخصوص مكان تواجد الكبير. Al Kabeer fights with many boxers and wins while Johnny calls Hazalqoum and asks for updates about Al Kabeer.

programme.title: الكبير الموسم 5 الحلقة 10 - Al Kabeer Season 5 Episode 10
programme.desc: يتعرض الكبير وحزلقوم لإصابات سطحية خلال مواجهتهما لبعضهما البعض، في حين يذهب ساشا إلى الكبير ويحاول إقناعه بتسليم صاروف بيك. Al Kabeer and Hazalqoum get minor injuries when they face each other and later, Sasha tries to convince Al Kabeer to turn Sarouf Beik in.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - HOONS
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the duo HOONS! HOONS is composed of two musicians of the same age - vocalist Lee Sang-hoon and keyboardist Lee Jong-hoon. They met each other in university and then made their debut together in 2016 with the single To You I Am. Thanks to their soft mellow music and sweet lyrics the duo mesmerized the public immediately and they are certainly making their way in the music industry building their fanbase and having their music featured in various TV shows. In this episode HOONS performs I C U Can't hide a love and many others to showcase the essence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the duo!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Hyun-chul
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the Korean father of city pop - Kim Hyun-chul! Kim Hyun-chul made his debut in 1989 with the album Kim Hyun-chul Vol. 1. With all songs composed written and arranged by the artist himself he pleasantly surprised the ears and souls of listeners with his jazz-infused music and eventually brought a new wave to the Korean music scene. Throughout his 32-year career Kim Hyun-chul gained much critical acclaim and commercial success earning the nickname the father of Korean city pop. Also his debut album was chosen as one of the All-Time 100 Greatest Albums of Korean Popular Music thanks to the influence it had had on the Korean music scene. Then in 2019 Kim Hyun-chul resumed his career after a break of 13 years and in celebration of the 30th anniversary of his debut. The album garnered much attention not only because of the anticipation of fans and critics but also because he brought an array of Korea’s leading artists along with him. His return coincided with the resurgence of city pop in Korea and he's back once again 2 years later in 2021 to continue with the momentum. Part I of Kim Hyun-chul's performance on I'm LIVE features What's the Matter? City Breeze & Love Song and Tears of Joy. Tune in to the show and meet the legend!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jung yup
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is top-notch singer Jung yup! Jung yup made his debut in 2003 as a member of the R&B group Brown Eyed Soul. Composed of four highly talented vocalists the group impressed the ears and souls of the public immediately. Then in 2007 Jung yup performed the song Nothing Better at one concert which went viral on the internet and attracted a lot of attention laying the foundation for his popularity. After a long long break this artist announced his much-anticipated return in April this year. Since then he has released two singles full of love and romance Waltz For You and DRIVE to melt listeners' hearts once again. In this episode Jung yup performs his new songs Waltz For You and DRIVE his all-time greatest hit Nothing Better and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this wonderful vocalist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - LUCY
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the super-talented quartet LUCY! LUCY is composed of violinist Shin Ye-chan vocalist Choi Sang-yeop producer and bassist Cho Won-sang and drummer and vocalist Shin Gwang-il. Since their debut in May last year they have been bringing a new wave to the Korean music scene especially with their unusual band configuration featuring a violinist. This past June the quartet released their 4th single album Gatcha! to engrave their name in the minds of the public and their first solo concert sold out in a minute proving their growing influence. In this episode LUCY performs I Got U Buddy Jogging and more to show off their prowess. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented quartet!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jeon Jin hee
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer and pianist Jeon Jin hee! This artist burst into the music industry as the leader of the quartet Ravie Nuage. Then she started her career as a solo artist in 2017 with the album Piano and Voice featuring a number of talented vocalists including Nine from Dear Cloud Kwak Jin-eon and Lee Young-hoon. Renowned for her ability to empower vocalists by offering instrumental support when they need it the most she provides empathy with her heartfelt music delivered through varied voices. In January this year Jeon Jin hee released her first instrumental album Breathing featuring 13 tracks she shared on her SoundCloud. Each track is associated with each month of the year letting us enjoy all 12 months in a new creative way. In this episode Jeon Jin hee performs Our Love Was Summer daymoon We Lost Us as well as summernight and rainsummernight from her latest album. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this wonderful artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Sam Kim
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer Sam Kim! This artist made himself known to the public in 2013 as the runner-up of the popular talent show K-pop Star Season 3. Then he made his official debut in 2016 and has been mesmerizing listeners with his velvety voice and songwriting skills since then. Thanks to his outstanding musicality he has also worked with a number of A-list musicians including IU Crush Zico and more. In June this year Sam Kim released his new single The Juice after a break of about 2 years. With a blend of retro pop and hip hop this autobiographic song depicts his worn-out state of mind interestingly through groovy dance moves. So he has proved that he can sing compose and even dance making us eagerly anticipate what more he has in store for us. In this episode Sam Kim performs The Juice Make Up Seattle and more to showcase the quintessence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented singer!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jung Seung Hwan
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Korea's ballad prince Jung Seung Hwan! Jung Seung Hwan known for his signature suave and captivating voice released his first physical album in two years — an EP titled Five Words Left Unsaid. The album is full of heartrending ballads that show off the artist's prowess including the lead single We From The First. It is about a man who develops romantic feelings for a close friend but is unable to express himself and quietly suffers alone. The album also features a song written by IU Love Letter which is known to be the first song she gave to another artist. The ballad prince is here on I'm LIVE once again to impress everyone with a brand new setlist including We From The First Voice Walking into the forest and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and let the artist melt your soul!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - JANNABI
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is JANNABI! JANNABI brought a huge retro sensation to Korea's music scene upon their debut in 2014. Since then the band has developed their unique retro vibe in both music and fashion. The band is back with its third full-length album The Land of Fantasy to nourish our souls once again. Through its 13 tracks all written by CHOI JUNG HOON with the help of guitarist KIM DO HYUNG this land of fantasy beautifully captures hope love courage and friendship. Just like their previous releases the new album provides an eclectic yet coherent collection of folk-rock ballads and playful pop-infused melodies but with greater depth and beauty. In this episode JANNABI performs A Ballad of Non Le Jon Confession Show The King of Romance Time I Know Where The Rainbow has Fallen and Bluebird Spread your wings! Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy their new songs live!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Damons year
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Damons year! This artist started his career as a musician in 2017 with the song Couldn't Sleep. Since then he has mesmerized listeners with his heartwarming melodies and sentiments. Also known for his poetic lyrics like I will hold your hands you can just relax It was like an ice burn Then one light came into my blurry eyes; it reached its hand out and lifted me up he presents music that suits all 365 days and 12 months of the year just like his stage name Damons year (day month year). In this episode he performs Rainbow ai Cherry Your Knight yours and Pattern to showcase the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: FRankly is made up of vocalist and guitarist Jung Seung-Hwan, guitarist Na Hyung-chul, drummer Ato, and bassist Koo Dong-uk. Deeply inspired by the 2000s Brit pop and American alternative rock, their music encapsulates authentic retro sentiments. However, they also display their trademark, youthful energy in many other elements of their musical work, such as album covers and song descriptions, making everyone fall for their kaleidoscopic qualities. In this episode, FRankly performs “TR,” “Grow Up!,” “DD (Drunk Dreaming,” “Help me,” and their latest single “Novel.”

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: BAND NAH is comprised of guitarist and vocalist Nah Sang-hyun, drummer Kang Hyun-woong, and bassist PAIIEK. This 88io debuted in 2015 with the EP, “Tingling,” and has released about 90 songs since then. Impressively enough, their music is as diverse as it is prolific. They have been evolving in unpredictable ways every time while maintaining their delightful spirit - no wonder why they are highly sought after for concerts and festivals. In this episode, BAND NAH performs “Shine,” which they released early this year, “Love Love Love,” Spotlight“ featured on the sound88ack of ”Yumi’s Cells,“ ”88,“ and ”1+1“ to showcase the essence of their musicality.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin! Isaac Hong made himself known to the public with his Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest-winning self-written song “Spring” in 2013. Since then, he has steadily built up his own musical world, marked by his trademark, mellow vocals and delicate sentiments. This time, he collaborated with renowned jazz pianist Sooyoung Chin to drop their project album, “Everland.” It is a mostly English-language album made through months of full collaboration, and the two describe it as “a record of their conversations over piano.” Using the common language of music, the two expanded their reach into each other’s respective universes. In this episode, Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin performs their songs “(n)everland,” “a bird,” “pages,” and also Hong’s own pieces “Rain” and “Stay.” Tune in to I’m LIVE and join their beautiful jazzy conversation!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter BOL4! BOL4 is An Ji-Yeong’s one-person band, known for its adorable sounds and lyrics depicting spring, stars, cherry blossoms, and the universe. In April, BOL4 released its new album, “LOVE.zip,” illustrating various forms of love through the language of music. Following the release, An also held a concert and impressed the audience with her unique, silky voice as well as her growth as a musician. BOL4 is making a comeback on I’m LIVE for the first time in 4 years, marking its third appearance, with the first one in 2017 and the second in 2019. programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: FRankly is made up of vocalist and guitarist Jung Seung-Hwan, guitarist Na Hyung-chul, drummer Ato, and bassist Koo Dong-uk. Deeply inspired by the 2000s Brit pop and American alternative rock, their music encapsulates authentic retro sentiments. However, they also display their trademark, youthful energy in many other elements of their musical work, such as album covers and song descriptions, making everyone fall for their kaleidoscopic qualities. In this episode, FRankly performs “TR,” “Grow Up!,” “DD (Drunk Dreaming,” “Help me,” and their latest single “Novel.”

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: BAND NAH is comprised of guitarist and vocalist Nah Sang-hyun, drummer Kang Hyun-woong, and bassist PAIIEK. This 88io debuted in 2015 with the EP, “Tingling,” and has released about 90 songs since then. Impressively enough, their music is as diverse as it is prolific. They have been evolving in unpredictable ways every time while maintaining their delightful spirit - no wonder why they are highly sought after for concerts and festivals. In this episode, BAND NAH performs “Shine,” which they released early this year, “Love Love Love,” Spotlight“ featured on the sound88ack of ”Yumi’s Cells,“ ”88,“ and ”1+1“ to showcase the essence of their musicality.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin! Isaac Hong made himself known to the public with his Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest-winning self-written song “Spring” in 2013. Since then, he has steadily built up his own musical world, marked by his trademark, mellow vocals and delicate sentiments. This time, he collaborated with renowned jazz pianist Sooyoung Chin to drop their project album, “Everland.” It is a mostly English-language album made through months of full collaboration, and the two describe it as “a record of their conversations over piano.” Using the common language of music, the two expanded their reach into each other’s respective universes. In this episode, Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin performs their songs “(n)everland,” “a bird,” “pages,” and also Hong’s own pieces “Rain” and “Stay.” Tune in to I’m LIVE and join their beautiful jazzy conversation!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter BOL4! BOL4 is An Ji-Yeong’s one-person band, known for its adorable sounds and lyrics depicting spring, stars, cherry blossoms, and the universe. In April, BOL4 released its new album, “LOVE.zip,” illustrating various forms of love through the language of music. Following the release, An also held a concert and impressed the audience with her unique, silky voice as well as her growth as a musician. BOL4 is making a comeback on I’m LIVE for the first time in 4 years, marking its third appearance, with the first one in 2017 and the second in 2019. In this episode, BOL4 performs “FRIEND THE END, ”ROME,“ ”Red Lipstick,“ ”Stars over me,“ and more to show off her artistry. Tune in to I’m LIVE and enjoy this new extraordinary performance presented by An Ji-Yeong!

programme.title: براد وصينية - Barrad Wa Seeniyya
programme.desc: برنامج حواري اجتماعي ترفيهي يتناول قضايا المرأة المغربية المعاصرة من خلال نقاش صريح. A light-hearted talk show that addresses issues Moroccan women face through open discussion.

programme.title: تلت التلاتة موسم 1 حلقة 6 - Telt El Talata Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: تعود فرح من سفرها لتكتشف ما فعلته فريدة بسمر، ويتوجب عليها إيجاد طريقة للتعامل مع الموقف الصعب الذي تعيشه. Farah returns from her trip only to find out what Farida has done to Samar, and must now find a way to deal with the difficult position she’s in.

programme.title: أنا حرة - Ana Horra
programme.desc: بعد أن تتطور الأمور من سيء إلى أسوا بينها وبين زوجها، تطلب نور الطلاق في محاولة للتحرر من العلاقة التي تعيشها والحصول على حضانة ابنتها فرح، غير أن الطريق نحو حياة رغيدة ومستقرة يظل مليئا بالتحديات. Fighting to break free from a dysfunctional marriage and secure custody of her daughter Farah, Nour faces an uphill battle on her path to a stable life.

programme.title: لعبة الحياة موسم 1 حلقة 25 - Lo'bat Al Haya Season 1 Episode 25
programme.desc: يمر أحد أهم وأقدم مستشفيات إسطنبول في محنة صعبة، ولكن سرعان ما يتدخل رئيس الأطباء الجديد في محاولة لإصلاح الأمور وإنقاذ حياة المرضى في آن واحد. As one of Istanbul’s oldest hospitals goes through a rough patch, a newly-appointed chief physician steps in for its revival while battling to save lives.

programme.title: جوابك ذهب - Jawabak Thahab
programme.desc: برنامج مسابقات ترفيهي ميداني تصور كل حلقة من حلقاته في مدينة مغربية مختلفة حيث يطرح أسئلة على المارة وستقدم جوائز ذهبية للفائزين. Exploring a new Moroccan city every episode, Jawabak Thahab poses questions to passers-by who get a chance at taking home a golden prize.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.
